structure_explanation.en: The sentence uses the pattern 〜のがすきです, which serves to say that one likes DOING something. The verb 読む (to read) is turned into a noun by the nominalizing particle の, and that whole action (本を読む = to read books) becomes the subject of what is liked, marked by が. At the end, すきです (to like) is a 形状詞 (な-adjective) that describes the preference. The topic わたしは indicates whose liking it is.

No fim, すきです (gostar) é um 形状詞 (adjetivo-na) que descreve a preferência. O tópico わたしは indica de quem é o gosto.

ops.issue: Literal renders 学校 as the SUBJECT of 休んだ ('a escola descansou/faltou'), but 学校を is the object of 休む ('faltar à escola'). Contradicts the (correct) expl and models a wrong parse of the sentence.
Gloss 'to print' is a wrong homograph sense (刷る=する); in this sentence し is just a segment of どうして ('why'). The pt gloss correctly says '(parte de どうして)'; the en gloss teaches a false meaning.

before.jp: どうして学校を休んだの
before.kana: どうしてがっこうをやすんだの

structure_explanation.en: The sentence opens with どうして (why?), the grammatical focus. The object 学校 (school) is marked by を, and the verb 休む (to be absent, to rest) appears in the casual past 休んだ. The final particle の gives an interested question tone. Here 学校を休む is the fixed expression for 'to be absent from school'.
structure_explanation.pt-BR: A frase abre com どうして (por quê?), o foco gramatical. O objeto 学校 (escola) é marcado por を, e o verbo 休む (faltar, descansar) aparece no passado casual 休んだ. A partícula final の dá tom de pergunta interessada. Aqui 学校を休む é a expressão fixa para 'faltar à escola'.
